- Small young leaf/shoot curled into a tight C/crescent shape
- Yellowish-green base color with scattered brown lesion patches
- Compact, crumpled appearance — not a mature, fully-opened leaf

**Candidate analysis:**
- **Anthracnose**: Reference shows brown, curled young leaves with lesions — very close match to test image. Description includes "semicircular lesions on margins of young leaves."
- **Cutting_Weevil**: Reference shows stripped bare shoots with leaves mostly consumed. Test image still has substantial leaf tissue — doesn't match.
- **Die_Back**: Reference shows uniformly darkened/dried long mature leaves curled lengthwise. Test image is a compact young shoot — doesn't match.

The test image most closely matches the Anthracnose reference — small curled young leaf with brown lesion patches, matching "semicircular lesions on margins of young leaves; large sunken lesions" pattern.
